title_ar: الدرس الأول من دورة الفرائض العلمية
title_en: The first lesson of the scholarly course on the law of inheritance shares
body_ar:
الكاتب : الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو

هذا هو الدرس الأول من سلسلة دروس دورة الفرائض العلمية التي قام الشيخ بتدريسها في المركز العلمي

بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

الحمد لله رب العالمين وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين، السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته، أما بعد فكان من خطة مركز تكوين العلماء أن تكون له دورات مفتوحة يشارك فيها طلابه وبعض أساتذته، وتكون مفتوحة للمجتمع كذلك للانتفاع العام في مختلف العلوم وقد سبق أن نفذ دورتين تامتين وجزئا من دورة، وهو اليوم ينفذ دورته الرابعة على بركة الله وهي في علم الفرائض أي علم التركات.
body_en:
Author: Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew.

This is the first lesson of the series of lessons of the scholarly course on the law of inheritance shares, which the Sheikh taught at the scholarly centre.

In the name of God, the Merciful, the Compassionate.

Praise be to God, Lord of the worlds. I pray for blessing and peace upon him who was sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his Companions and all who are guided by his guidance and follow his sunnah until the Day of Judgement. Peace be upon you, and the mercy of God and His blessings. To proceed: it was part of the plan of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars that it should hold open courses in which its students and some of its teachers take part, open to the wider community as well, for the general benefit, in the various branches of knowledge. It has already carried out two complete courses and part of a course, and today it is carrying out its fourth course, with God's blessing, and it is on the science of the inheritance shares, that is, the science of estates.

flags.arabic: وقد سبق أن نفذ دورتين تامتين وجزئا من دورة، وهو اليوم ينفذ دورته الرابعة
flags.context: the Sheikh's account of how many courses the centre has held
options: translate as given, with the arithmetic as it stands
translate as given and add an editorial note on the apparent discrepancy
reconcile the count in the English
flags.note: The arithmetic in the sentence does not obviously add up in English: two complete courses and part of a third are said to have preceded, and this is called the fourth. The count is reconcilable if the partial course is counted as the third, which is the natural reading in the Arabic. Recorded here because a reviewer will notice it; no change has been made to the English. Option 2 is not acceptable under the rule against silently fixing the source.

EXCERPT ONLY. The published text is the opening of the lesson and breaks off; the full transcript is offered as a .docx download ('taḥmīl al-māddah'). The English ends exactly where the Arabic ends. The download-link label has been removed from body_ar as a navigation element and recorded in source_download_link. Unlike ids 623 and 625 in the same series, the excerpt here ends on a completed sentence and poses no unanswered question, so it is not marked critical_for_display.
The title and the byline agree on the lesson number in this record, unlike ids 623 and 625.

'The science of the inheritance shares, that is, the science of estates' renders ʿilm al-farāʾiḍ ay ʿilm al-tarikāt — the Sheikh's own gloss of the discipline's name, kept as a gloss rather than collapsed into one term.
The byline calls the venue 'the scholarly centre' (al-markaz al-ʿilmī) and the body names it as the Centre for the Formation of Scholars (Markaz Takwīn al-ʿUlamāʾ). Both are rendered as given.
